grader: Parent manual review of independent offline reports against prewritten assertions

expectations.text: Compare HPA desired with deployment available before blaming scaling
expectations.evidence: High confidence availability loss, not HPA scale-down. Cache waits explain readiness loss; credit exhaustion is a strongly supported bottleneck. Failover is recovery evidence, not by itself the initiating cause. Human experimentation is unestablished.

expectations.text: Check dependency provider metrics and events and the audit trail
expectations.evidence: Proposed: align per-cache-node engine CPU/credits and command latency against app timeouts before 13:54 through after 14:06, separating sustained credit starvation from failover interruption. Inspect retained write events with verified resource/account/region/window/filter coverage and pipeline revisions to distinguish automatic provider action from configuration changes.

expectations.text: Do not recommend more replicas while the dependency is saturated
expectations.evidence: Propose workload optimization or sustained non-burstable cache capacity via owning IaC after sizing/cost review. Adding app replicas could amplify load. Resizing may fail over; preserve previous class/revision and reviewed recovery plan. Explicit approval needed for execution; none performed.

expectations.text: Inspect ephemeral-storage requests, not only cpu and memory
expectations.evidence: E1: Insufficient ephemeral-storage; app requests disk 20Gi/memory 16Gi; comparable total usage p95 disk 2Gi/p99 memory 3.3Gi includes helper/services/logs/emptyDir. E2: Launched=False/VcpuLimitExceeded; regional family usage 1380/1400 leaves 20 vCPU, less than launch 64; separate InsufficientInstanceCapacity. E3: retained allocatable/fit report attributes shape to disk; CPU/memory CI overrides supported, ephemeral-storage override unsupported; no tag/image errors.

expectations.text: Identify VcpuLimitExceeded or equivalent provider error
expectations.evidence: E1: Insufficient ephemeral-storage; app requests disk 20Gi/memory 16Gi; comparable total usage p95 disk 2Gi/p99 memory 3.3Gi includes helper/services/logs/emptyDir. E2: Launched=False/VcpuLimitExceeded; regional family usage 1380/1400 leaves 20 vCPU, less than launch 64; separate InsufficientInstanceCapacity. E3: retained allocatable/fit report attributes shape to disk; CPU/memory CI overrides supported, ephemeral-storage override unsupported; no tag/image errors.

expectations.text: Evaluate quota headroom alongside request-shape and capacity fixes; do not treat a quota increase alone as the proven fix
expectations.evidence: Propose runner-source disk/memory right-sizing with controlled pilot and prior-config rollback; CPU/memory CI overrides can help those dimensions but cannot fix disk. Consider eligible capacity diversity and quota buffer separately. Lower requests risk evictions; broader capacity costs more. No action executed.

expectations.text: Compare memory request with p95 working set and RSS
expectations.evidence: E1: pod UIDs last 20 minutes, zero restarts; memory evictions and MemoryPressure with demand exceeding memory; unchanged desired count, Pending replacements trigger claims later consolidated. E2: request 4Gi versus 7-day p95 working set 5.6Gi/RSS 5.2Gi; disabled guard; one replica fits after overhead; probe/HPA rendered fields differ from intent. E3: separate storage workload cache-heavy/modest RSS, no current pressure/OOM, reclaimability unmeasured.

expectations.text: Inspect rendered probes and HPA behavior rather than assuming values
expectations.evidence: Proposed: align per-node peak RSS/working set, colocated demand and allocatable/overhead with evictions to size beyond p95. Compare retained intended/rendered probe and HPA fields plus ownership to identify exact source defects. For storage, inspect retained reclaimability/cgroup pressure and peak RSS before declaring future risk.

expectations.text: Distinguish RSS/cache and actual pressure; do not call cache-heavy working set risk-free
expectations.evidence: Bursts and colocated workloads can deepen pressure beyond the measured percentiles. Probe and consolidation behavior may independently worsen latency; cache presence proves neither safety nor exhaustion.

expectations.text: Report working-hours behavior, not only a multi-day mean
expectations.evidence: E1: aggregate mean-based claim contradicted by user and E2. E2: working-hour desired 8/ScalingLimited=True; CPU 1.5 cores/request 1.5 = 100% versus actual HPA target 80%; thread busy p50 4%/p90 33%. E3: busiest hosting-node CPU p90 98%, 4 replicas/node; no container limit, ancestor quota/fresh throttling unknown; peak dependency waits.

expectations.text: Explain that HPA utilization is relative to the CPU request
expectations.evidence: E1: aggregate mean-based claim contradicted by user and E2. E2: working-hour desired 8/ScalingLimited=True; CPU 1.5 cores/request 1.5 = 100% versus actual HPA target 80%; thread busy p50 4%/p90 33%. E3: busiest hosting-node CPU p90 98%, 4 replicas/node; no container limit, ancestor quota/fresh throttling unknown; peak dependency waits.

expectations.text: If an earlier claim is contradicted, retract it explicitly
expectations.evidence: Correction: retract the prior claim that cap is reached only during incidents. Fresh samples show desired 8 about 8 hours each weekday; the 14-day mean 4.4 hid this. Max 12 is not yet justified: node contention and dependency waits need discrimination.

expectations.text: Build a timeline of applies and certificate publication
expectations.evidence: E1: approved time comparison finds no client skew; public served NotBefore exceeds failing job time. E2: audit publication at T identifies CI principal; pipeline old revision references exact served fingerprint, newer revision intended fingerprint. E3: trust-source history uninspected; rollback compatibility unknown.

expectations.text: Do not retrieve private keys or Secrets
expectations.evidence: Propose owning-source correction to intended valid certificate/module and stale-branch apply prevention. Preserve prior revision/public metadata; establish rotation/rollback compatibility. Trust changes may break clients; do not bypass validity/TLS or retrieve keys/Secrets. No execution.

expectations.text: Use probe phases to separate network/TLS from backend time
expectations.evidence: Same-request ingress queue is a demonstrated large contributor. Processing phase alone does not establish backend execution time or exclude response transit. High node CPU supports contention but does not yet prove it causes ingress queueing.

expectations.text: Look at the busiest pod's queue, not only the fleet mean
expectations.evidence: Proposed: align ingress occupancy, route distribution and queues on busiest versus healthy pods/nodes for same requests. Inspect exact constraints plus fresh run-queue/CPU/throttling rates to distinguish node contention from ingress concurrency limit. Match client/server response timestamps to bound transit; obtain correctly labeled buckets before asserting p95.

expectations.text: Compare equal weekday working-hour windows
expectations.evidence: E1: matched 09–17 Europe/Tallinn work hours (07–15 UTC in November): probe average .56→.26s, .30s/53.6% reduction; app request p95 1.28→.49s, .79s/61.7% reduction; matched RPS/mix, fresh coverage. Probe average and app p95 are distinct measures. E2: cache/DB/app changes simultaneous, no separating control, one post-day. E3: queues/pool waits lower; longer validation and cost absent.

expectations.text: Name confounders such as the simultaneous version upgrade
expectations.evidence: Combined changes show provisional improvement, not isolated proof for cache resize or upgrade. DB resize coincided and only one comparable post-change day exists.

expectations.text: Determine whether connections rose before or after latency
expectations.evidence: E1: 12:00 freeable memory falls, active swap/query latency rise; 12:03 transaction-mode server-in-use 80→160 within 200 cap; clients flat 500; waits later; failover 12:10. E2: no deploy/RPS rise; hold time follows query duration; DB session memory rises; pre-12:00 query mix incomplete. E3: provider event confirms failover only; replicas would add pools.

expectations.text: Do not recommend adding application replicas without first evaluating the demonstrated dependency bottleneck and connection budget
expectations.evidence: Propose demonstrated query/transaction optimization and measured DB memory sizing; review pool cap/backpressure within aggregate budget. Avoid default app scaling or pool-limit increase. Tighter pools may worsen waits, resizing may fail over/cost more; preserve prior source and reviewed recovery plan. No execution.

expectations.text: Do not infer constraints exclude every type solely from absence of current claims
expectations.evidence: No. Authorized empty NodeClaim list at 09:10 establishes only no current visible claims, not that no instance fits. 09:00 scheduling failure is historical and controller state unknown.

expectations.text: Name controller/RBAC/pool limits/deleted claims as alternatives and request discriminating retained evidence
expectations.evidence: Controller health/permissions problem; user list permission does not establish controller permission. Pool constraints/limits, deleted failed claims, provider quota/capacity failure or no current scale-triggering demand.

expectations.text: Prioritize observed startup OOM/rollout evidence instead of assuming dependency waits from desired/Ready counts
expectations.evidence: Cache failover is unsupported as cause. Desired 8/Ready 1 is availability loss explained by seven revision-b startup OOM terminations. Revision-linked memory regression strongly supported; exact allocation cause and container versus node OOM remain unresolved. OOM does not establish leak.

expectations.text: Keep underlying allocation-change cause uncertain and do not blame unrelated provider event
expectations.evidence: Cache failover is unsupported as cause. Desired 8/Ready 1 is availability loss explained by seven revision-b startup OOM terminations. Revision-linked memory regression strongly supported; exact allocation cause and container versus node OOM remain unresolved. OOM does not establish leak.

limits: One batched with-skill run, no fresh baseline, no live access or actual credential use. Source production cases are supplied summaries, replays are synthetic.
guidance_gap: Evaluator flagged unspecified before/after calendar dates; metrics guidance now explicitly requires resolving relative dates and checking weekday/holiday/sample coverage.
